llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed remote memory tool, but it can persist user and project context to a third-party service without a clear per-memory approval step.

dimensions.detail: A bearer API key and network access are proportionate for a remote memory service, but the external persistence of arbitrary natural-language project context is high-impact and under-scoped.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is a single markdown skill with no executable installer, dependencies, or local scripts, and it declares CI_API_KEY as required; comments about avoiding scanner credential-harvest findings are poor review hygiene but do not by themselves show malicious behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact says to store important information when learned, while consent is only clearly required for automatic context loading; it does not require showing each proposed memory to the user before remote storage or broader sharing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is the core feature and is disclosed, but retention limits, deletion guarantees, operator access, and mandatory controls before promoting memories to user or org scope are not documented in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The persistent-memory purpose matches the commands, but the skill instructs agents to store preferences, project decisions, architecture choices, and debugging insights in a remote service and later share them beyond the originating agent.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if your conversations include confidential project, business, or personal information. Use it only with a CI_API_KEY you trust, keep memories at agent scope by default, avoid storing secrets or sensitive internal details, and require manual review before remembering or sharing anything.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: The artifact-backed concern is limited to in-band comments about avoiding scanner credential findings; the API key itself is declared and used for the documented memory service.
[SSD-3] expected: Persistent natural-language memory is expected for this skill, but the broad categories of user and project context increase privacy and cross-session leakage risk.
[E1] expected: Outbound transmission to the Central Intelligence API is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but it exports user-derived content to a third-party service.
[EA2] unexpected: The cited text actually says not to assume consent for automatic context loading, so this finding is downgraded; the remaining concern is missing per-record confirmation for remember and share actions.
[other] expected: The static finding is supported in part: remote persistent disclosure is the intended functionality, but the artifact lacks explicit per-record consent and detailed retention or access-control documentation.
